title: SoroBeacon — Overview (SLO & Health)
description: Top-level operator view answering 'is it working, and if not, where?' built on SLO recording indicators and core health signals.

panels.title: Evaluation Freshness (Seconds Since Last Poll)
panels.description: Good: < 15s (SLO target: 99.5% of cycles complete within 30s). If > 30s, open the Evaluation Dashboard and docs/operations/health-checks.md.

panels.title: Chain Tip Lag (Ledgers Behind)
panels.description: Good: <= 3 ledgers on steady-state polling. Growing lag indicates RPC slowness or heavy rule evaluation.

panels.title: Delivery Success Ratio (5m)
panels.description: Good: >= 99.0% successful deliveries across channels. If degraded, drill down into the Delivery and Channels dashboards.

panels.title: Dead-Letter Backlog
panels.description: Good: 0 dead-lettered deliveries awaiting review. Any non-zero value means retries exhausted; see docs/operations/delivery-failures.md.

panels.title: API Read Availability & P95 Latency
panels.description: Good: >= 99.9% non-5xx responses and p95 < 250ms. See Store & Retention dashboard if latency climbs.

panels.title: Poller Panics & Chain Reorgs (Last 1h)
panels.description: Good: 0 panics and 0 reorgs. Non-zero panics indicate a recovered crash in the poll loop; see docs/operations/retention-and-reorg.md.
